notes: float64 arithmetic in the spec's exact order; float64(…) conversions round each product, since the Go spec otherwise allows fusing x*y + z into an FMA.
Each row is packed into a reused byte slice (8 pixels per byte, MSB first) and written to a 64 KiB bufio.Writer.
Default GOAMD64=v1 (no FMA instructions); static binary on a scratch image.
